label: Aquarius
source_text: Keywords: individualistic, assertive, independent, humanitarian, inventive, original, eccentric, opinionated, intellectual, idealistic, cool, friendly, detached. Sun in Aquarius: One of the standout characteristics of those born under the Sun Sign of Aquarius is their unwillingness to follow the beaten track. With advancement and progress on their minds, there can be an irreverence to old and outdated ways of thinking and doing things.
description_draft: This means going one's own way: inventive, opinionated and eccentric, caring about humanity at large while staying cool and detached up close, friendly with everyone, and irreverent toward outdated ways.
nearest_existing: nonconformist / eccentric / iconoclastic (also humanitarian, detached, independent): the sign bundles the nonconformist's refusal of the common path with humanitarian idealism and a cool, friendly detachment; the plain traits each carry one strand.
notes: Element air, modality fixed. Wikipedia's Aquarius (astrology) article, checked 2026-10-07, carries no Western personality portrait (only a Hindu-astrology aside naming innovation, humanitarianism and persistence), and 'Astrological sign' gives only element keywords; the packet's fallback applied and Cafe Astrology's sign page was used as the popular portrait, cross-checked against astrology.com/zodiac-signs/aquarius ('visionaries, progressive souls', 'social conscience', 'so many friends and acquaintances'; weaknesses 'cold, distant, or unfeeling', 'contrarian nature'). Strength: the keyword list mixes flattering (inventive, humanitarian, friendly) and unflattering (eccentric, opinionated, detached) terms about evenly; kept.
set_review: Twelve drafts, 29-32 words each, one shape: a short gloss of the sign's governing drive, a colon, then three to five behaviors mixing the source's flattering and unflattering keywords in roughly the source's proportion. The source situation is uniform: Wikipedia's twelve sign articles and 'Astrological sign' (all checked 2026-10-07) carry no personality portraits, so every sign's source_text is Cafe Astrology's keyword list plus the opening of its 'Sun in <sign>' section, with astrology.com's sign page as a second popular portrait quoted in each entry's notes; the two agree on every sign's conventional traits, and where a draft leans on a cross-check phrase the notes say so. The ring order (Aries ... Pisces) is the calendar order of the sun's passage, not a similarity order, so neighbors are not meant to resemble each other; what is readable off the set is the element cycle fire-earth-air-water repeating three times (each entry's notes record element and modality), which groups Aries/Leo/Sagittarius (drive, warmth, energy), Taurus/Virgo/Capricorn (steadiness, exactness, discipline), Gemini/Libra/Aquarius (talk, balance, ideas) and Cancer/Scorpio/Pisces (feeling, intensity, sensitivity); the drafts keep those family resemblances without naming the elements. Distinguishability at 32 words was not a problem; no member needed the 36-word allowance. Strength: these composite portraits come out milder than the corpus's single plain traits because each spreads over five or six traits; three signs (Capricorn, Leo, Pisces) have a primary source with no real fault side and come out more flattering than their cross-check, flagged in their notes for Roger; Scorpio is the least flattering, as the conventional portrait is.

label: Aries
source_text: Keywords: active, initiating, leading, independent, aggressive, impatient, combative, energetic, pioneering, naive, assertive. Sun in Aries: Aries is the first sign of the zodiac, and Aries natives are the first to start—and the first to finish—whatever they set out to do. [...] People with Sun in Aries are direct, straightforward, and uncomplicated. They expect the same from others, and are baffled when they don't always get it. [astrology.com, Aries page, https://www.astrology.com/zodiac-signs/aries] "Prone to impatience and a short temper"
description_draft: This means charging first into whatever one sets out to do: direct, energetic and independent, quick to lead and quick to anger, impatient with anyone who is not as straightforward.
nearest_existing: bold / impulsive / impatient (also brash, confrontational): the sign is the bold person's rush forward plus a leader's initiative and a short temper, with bafflement at others' indirectness; none of the plain traits has all three.
notes: Element fire, modality cardinal. Source fallback as for the set (Wikipedia's Aries (astrology) article has no portrait); cross-check astrology.com/zodiac-signs/aries: 'Bold · Independent · Passionate · Determined · Impulsive'; strengths 'Natural-born leaders', 'Fearless and direct in communication'; challenges 'Prone to impatience and a short temper', 'Tendency to act before thinking'. Strength: keywords evenly split between flattering and not (aggressive, impatient, combative, naive); kept.

label: artistic (Holland)
source_text: Work involves creating original visual artwork, performances, written works, food, or music for a variety of media, or applying artistic principles to the design of various objects and materials. Artistic occupations are often associated with visual arts, applied arts and design, performing arts, music, creative writing, media, or culinary art.
description_draft: This means being drawn to work that creates something original: visual art, performances, writing, music or food for any medium, or bringing an artist's eye to the design of objects and materials.
nearest_existing: artistic (plain corpus trait) / creative / aesthete: deliberate near-duplicate by name; the typed version is a vocational interest (wanting to make original work or design for a living), not a temperament or a taste, and lists the kinds of work rather than a sensibility.
notes: O*NET's descriptor text describes work, not a person, so the inside voice is 'being drawn to work that ...', uniformly across the six. The person-oriented Interest Profiler wording ('People with Artistic interests like work that ...') could not be fetched: mynextmove.org/explore/ip redirects to onetinterestprofiler.org, a script-driven app whose page carries no descriptive text, and onetcenter.org/content.html gives the same descriptor sentences as onetonline.org (its 1.B.1 deep link returned 404). Strength: neutral, as the instrument is; no negatives exist in the source.
set_review: Six drafts, 28-32 words, one shape: 'This means being drawn to work that ...', a gloss of the kind of work, a colon, then the activities and fields from O*NET's two descriptor sentences. All six source_texts are O*NET OnLine's 'Interests' descriptor pages (1.B.1.a-f): the current short definition ('Work involves ...') plus the associated-fields sentence; the onetonline.org browse page and onetcenter.org's content model carry the same wording, and the Interest Profiler's person-oriented wording was not fetchable (see this entry's notes), so no member has a different grain of source. The ring in RIASEC order is readable off the drafts: realistic (hands, machines, outdoors) to investigative (study and research) to artistic (making original work) to social (helping and teaching people) to enterprising (managing and selling, leading people) to conventional (procedures and data) and back to realistic; Prediger's Things-People axis is realistic against social and his Data-Ideas axis is conventional/enterprising against investigative/artistic, both visible without being seeded, as the queue notes want. Two members share a name with plain corpus traits (artistic, conventional) and are recorded as deliberate near-duplicates whose Holland sense differs materially. Strength: O*NET's descriptions are neutral vocational interests with no vice side, so all six come out milder than the corpus's plain traits; that is the instrument's nature and is uniform across the set.

label: Cancer
source_text: Keywords: gentle, conservative, feeling, nurturing, defensive, contemplative. Sun in Cancer: Sun in Cancer natives have a strong survival instinct. They are protective of those they care about, and of themselves too. They are often quite reticent about sharing their inner selves to the rest of the world, and are often caught up in reminisce. [astrology.com, Cancer page, https://www.astrology.com/zodiac-signs/cancer] "Cancer, the fourth sign of the zodiac, is all about home. Those born under this horoscope sign are 'roots' kinds of people, and take great pleasure in the comforts of home and family."
description_draft: This means being ruled by feeling and home: gentle and nurturing toward one's own, protective of them and of oneself, reticent about one's inner life with outsiders, and given to reminiscing.
nearest_existing: nurturing / family_oriented / homebody / sentimental (also guarded): the sign joins the nurturer's care with a defensive, protective reserve and a backward-looking sentimentality; the plain traits each take one of these.
notes: Element water, modality cardinal. Source fallback as for the set (Wikipedia's Cancer (astrology) article has no portrait); cross-check astrology.com/zodiac-signs/cancer: 'all about home', 'maternal, domestic, and love to nurture others', 'prizes family history', 'get emotional about things'; weakness 'hard to let go and make changes'. 'Home' in the draft comes from the cross-check. Strength: keywords mostly gentle, with 'defensive' and 'conservative' as the unflattering side; kept at that level.

label: Capricorn
source_text: Keywords: tenacious, conservative, resourceful, disciplined, wise, ambitious, prudent, constant. Sun in Capricorn: Capricorn is a feet-on-the-ground, eye-on-the-prize sign. Those with Sun in Capricorn have a realistic, grounded approach to life that can be seen no matter how dreamy the rest of the birth chart suggests. These people know how to do things, and to get things done.
description_draft: This means being grounded and ambitious at once: disciplined, prudent and tenacious, working steadily toward a distant goal for as long as it takes, and knowing how to get things done.
nearest_existing: ambitious / self_disciplined / persevering / prudent (also practical, long_term_oriented): the sign is ambition made patient and practical; the plain ambitious wants the top, the typed version climbs toward it one step at a time for years.
notes: Element earth, modality cardinal. Source fallback as for the set (Wikipedia's Capricorn (astrology) article has no portrait); cross-check astrology.com/zodiac-signs/capricorn: 'all about hard work', 'put in a full day at the office', 'one step at a time', 'dedicated to their goals, almost to the point of stubbornness'; weaknesses 'judgmental', 'materialistic, and even miserly', hiding pain 'behind a mask of self-sufficiency'. Strength: Cafe Astrology's keywords for this sign are all flattering or neutral ('conservative' the only non-compliment), so the draft is correspondingly flattering and milder than the cross-check, which carries stubbornness, judgment and miserliness. Flag for Roger: one of three signs whose primary source has no fault side (with Leo and Pisces).

label: conventional (Holland)
source_text: Work involves following procedures and regulations to organize information or data, typically in a business setting. Conventional occupations are often associated with office work, accounting, mathematics/statistics, information technology, finance, or human resources.
description_draft: This means being drawn to work that keeps information and data in order by set procedures and regulations: office work, accounting, finance, statistics, information systems and human resources.
nearest_existing: conventional (plain corpus trait) / methodical / organized / rule_abiding: deliberate near-duplicate by name, and the sense differs materially: the plain trait is conforming to social norms; the typed version is a vocational interest in procedural, data-ordering office work and says nothing about conformity outside it.
notes: Shortest of the six at 28 words because the source is the shortest; inside 18-32. O*NET's descriptor is neutral; the corpus's plain 'conventional' carries a judgment the typed version does not. Source situation as in the set_review on artistic (Holland).

label: Enneagram 1
source_text: The Rational, Idealistic Type: Principled, Purposeful, Self-Controlled, and Perfectionistic. Ones are conscientious and ethical, with a strong sense of right and wrong. They are teachers, crusaders, and advocates for change: always striving to improve things, but afraid of making a mistake. Well-organized, orderly, and fastidious, they try to maintain high standards, but can slip into being critical and perfectionistic. They typically have problems with resentment and impatience. At their Best: wise, discerning, realistic, and noble. Can be morally heroic.
description_draft: This means living by a strong sense of right and wrong: always striving to improve things, orderly and fastidious, afraid of making a mistake, and slipping into criticism, perfectionism and resentment.
nearest_existing: perfectionist / principled / conscientious (also fastidious, critical): the type is the principled person's ethics driving the perfectionist's standards, with the fear of error and the resentment as the price; the plain traits each carry one piece.
notes: The 'At their Best' sentence is omitted from the draft, uniformly across the nine (see set_review). The Institute's trademarked nickname ('The Reformer') and the system are unnamed. The one-line summary is identical on the overview page and the type page for this type. 'Impatience' from the problems list did not fit at 32 and is the one source item left out.
set_review: Nine drafts, 29-32 words, one shape: a gloss of the type's core drive, a colon, then the Institute's own adjectives and 'but can slip into' faults in the order the source gives them. All nine source_texts are the Enneagram Institute's type pages (enneagraminstitute.com/type-N): the one-line summary plus the 'in Brief' paragraph; the overview page (type-descriptions) gives the same one-liners with small adjective differences for types 2, 3, 4 and 7, recorded in those entries' notes. Nicknames (Reformer, Helper, Achiever, Individualist, Investigator, Loyalist, Enthusiast, Challenger, Peacemaker) and the system are unnamed in every draft. One uniform omission: each paragraph ends with an 'At their Best:' sentence describing the type at its healthiest ('wise, discerning, realistic, and noble'; 'unconditional love for others'; ...); it was left out of all nine because it is an aspiration, not the portrait, and would tilt the whole set flattering. The paragraphs themselves are balanced, each pairing virtues with a 'but can also' clause and a 'typically have problems with' sentence, so the drafts sit at about the corpus's plain-trait strength rather than markedly milder; the source's hedges ('sometimes', 'usually', 'tend to be') are rendered as plain words ('at times', 'too readily'), not dropped. The ring is the figure's numbering 1-9 and is readable as such; the drafts also keep the three triads legible without naming them (8-9-1: control, peace, rightness; 2-3-4: being needed, admired, distinct; 5-6-7: knowing, security, experience), the Enneagram's analogue of the zodiac's elements. Distinguishability at 32 words was not a problem; no member needed the 36-word allowance. Where a source item was dropped for length it is named in that entry's notes.

label: Enneagram 2
source_text: The Caring, Interpersonal Type: Generous, Demonstrative, People-Pleasing, and Possessive. Twos are empathetic, sincere, and warm-hearted. They are friendly, generous, and self-sacrificing, but can also be sentimental, flattering, and people-pleasing. They are well-meaning and driven to be close to others, but can slip into doing things for others in order to be needed. They typically have problems with possessiveness and with acknowledging their own needs. At their Best: unselfish and altruistic, they have unconditional love for others.
description_draft: This means being warm-hearted and self-sacrificing: needing to be close to people, helping them so as to be needed, flattering and eager to please, possessive, and slow to admit one's own needs.
nearest_existing: helpful / nurturing / clingy / other_focused (also sycophantic for the flattering): the type is helpfulness with a motive, giving in order to be needed, plus possessiveness of the people helped; the plain helpful has no such motive and the plain clingy no such generosity.
notes: 'At their Best' omitted as across the set. Nickname ('The Helper') unnamed. One-liner differs between pages: overview 'Demonstrative, Generous, People-Pleasing, and Possessive', type page 'Generous, Demonstrative, ...'; the type page's order is recorded. Strength: the source's 'can slip into' and 'problems with' clauses are rendered as plain behaviors (helping so as to be needed; possessive; slow to admit one's own needs); 'sentimental' did not fit at 32.

label: Enneagram 3
source_text: The Success-Oriented, Pragmatic Type: Adaptable, Excelling, Driven, and Image-Conscious. Threes are self-assured, attractive, and charming. Ambitious, competent, and energetic, they can also be status-conscious and highly driven for advancement. They are diplomatic and poised, but can also be overly concerned with their image and what others think of them. They typically have problems with workaholism and competitiveness. At their Best: self-accepting, authentic, everything they seem to be—role models who inspire others.
description_draft: This means being charming, poised and ambitious: competent and energetic, conscious of status and bent on advancement, working without rest, competing hard, and preoccupied with one's image and what others think.
nearest_existing: ambitious / status_seeking / competitive / performance_oriented (also charismatic): the type is ambition fused with image-management; the plain ambitious wants the achievement, the typed version wants to be seen achieving and adapts itself to be admired.
notes: 'At their Best' omitted as across the set. Nickname ('The Achiever') unnamed. One-liner differs between pages: overview 'Adaptive', type page 'Adaptable'; the type page's is recorded. 'Overly concerned with their image' is rendered as 'preoccupied with one's image', keeping the source's strength; 'workaholism' as 'working without rest'.

label: Enneagram 4
source_text: The Sensitive, Introspective Type: Expressive, Dramatic, Self-Absorbed, and Temperamental. Fours are self-aware, sensitive, and reserved. They are emotionally honest, creative, and personal, but can also be moody and self-conscious. Withholding themselves from others due to feeling vulnerable and defective, they can also feel disdainful and exempt from ordinary ways of living. They typically have problems with melancholy, self-indulgence, and self-pity. At their Best: inspired and highly creative, they are able to renew themselves and transform their experiences.
description_draft: This means being sensitive, creative and emotionally honest: holding back from others out of feeling vulnerable and flawed, moody and self-conscious, disdainful of ordinary living, and prone to melancholy and self-pity.
nearest_existing: melancholic / self_absorbed / introspective / self_pitying (also temperamental, self_conscious): the type adds to the melancholic's sadness a sense of being different and exempt from the ordinary, and a creative, emotionally honest expressiveness; no plain trait has the 'exempt' strand.
notes: 'At their Best' omitted as across the set. Nickname ('The Individualist') unnamed. One-liner differs between pages: overview 'The Sensitive, Withdrawn Type', type page 'The Sensitive, Introspective Type'; the type page's is recorded. 'Defective' rendered as 'flawed'; 'typically have problems with' rendered as 'prone to'; 'self-indulgence' from the problems list did not fit at 32 and is the one source item left out.

label: Enneagram 5
source_text: The Intense, Cerebral Type: Perceptive, Innovative, Secretive, and Isolated. Fives are alert, insightful, and curious. They are able to concentrate and focus on developing complex ideas and skills. Independent, innovative, and inventive, they can also become preoccupied with their thoughts and imaginary constructs. They become detached, yet high-strung and intense. They typically have problems with eccentricity, nihilism, and isolation. At their Best: visionary pioneers, often ahead of their time, and able to see the world in an entirely new way.
description_draft: This means living in one's head: alert, curious and inventive, concentrating on complex ideas and skills, preoccupied with one's own thoughts and constructs, detached yet high-strung, and drifting toward eccentricity and isolation.
nearest_existing: cerebral / solitary / detached / curious (also eccentric, isolated): the type is the cerebral person's absorption in ideas with the withdrawal that follows from it, intense rather than cool; the plain detached lacks the intensity and the plain curious the withdrawal.
notes: 'At their Best' omitted as across the set. Nickname ('The Investigator') unnamed. One-liner identical on both pages. 'Nihilism' from the problems list did not fit at 32 and is the one source item left out; 'secretive' from the one-liner is carried only implicitly by 'detached'.

label: Enneagram 6
source_text: The Committed, Security-Oriented Type: Engaging, Responsible, Anxious, and Suspicious. Sixes are reliable, hard-working, responsible, and trustworthy. Excellent 'troubleshooters,' they foresee problems and foster cooperation, but can also become defensive, evasive, and anxious—running on stress while complaining about it. They can be cautious and indecisive, but also reactive, defiant and rebellious. They typically have problems with self-doubt and suspicion. At their Best: internally stable and self-reliant, courageously championing themselves and others.
description_draft: This means craving security: reliable, hard-working and responsible while running on anxiety, foreseeing problems before they come, cautious and indecisive one moment and defiant the next, doubting oneself and suspecting others.
nearest_existing: anxious / cautious / dependable / paranoid (also loyal, indecisive): the type is dependability powered by anxiety, with the swing between caution and defiance that no plain trait has; the plain anxious is not reliable for it and the plain dependable is not anxious.
notes: 'At their Best' omitted as across the set. Nickname ('The Loyalist') unnamed. One-liner identical on both pages. 'Craving security' in the opening comes from the one-liner's 'Security-Oriented' and the paragraph's thrust; 'trustworthy', 'foster cooperation', 'defensive, evasive' did not fit at 32. The fetched paragraph opens with the one-liner repeated in lower case ('The committed, security-oriented type.'), dropped from source_text as duplicate.

label: Enneagram 7
source_text: The Busy, Variety-Seeking Type: Spontaneous, Versatile, Acquisitive, and Scattered. Sevens are extroverted, optimistic, versatile, and spontaneous. Playful, high-spirited, and practical, they can also misapply their many talents, becoming over-extended, scattered, and undisciplined. They constantly seek new and exciting experiences, but can become distracted and exhausted by staying on the go. They typically have problems with impatience and impulsiveness. At their Best: they focus their talents on worthwhile goals, becoming appreciative, joyous, and satisfied.
description_draft: This means chasing the next exciting experience: outgoing, optimistic, playful and spontaneous, spreading one's many talents too thin, scattered and undisciplined, impatient, impulsive, and worn out from never stopping.
nearest_existing: restless / distractible / impulsive / hedonistic (also spontaneous, energetic, optimistic): the type is the restless person's hunger for new experience with an optimistic, playful temper and the scattering of talent that follows; the plain hedonistic seeks pleasure, the typed version seeks novelty and stimulation.
notes: 'At their Best' omitted as across the set. Nickname ('The Enthusiast') unnamed. One-liner differs between pages: overview 'The Busy, Fun-Loving Type: Spontaneous, Versatile, Distractible, and Scattered', type page 'The Busy, Variety-Seeking Type: Spontaneous, Versatile, Acquisitive, and Scattered'; the type page's is recorded. 'Extroverted' rendered 'outgoing'; 'over-extended' as 'spreading one's many talents too thin'; 'practical' did not fit at 32.

label: Enneagram 8
source_text: The Powerful, Dominating Type: Self-Confident, Decisive, Willful, and Confrontational. Eights are self-confident, strong, and assertive. Protective, resourceful, straight-talking, and decisive, but can also be ego-centric and domineering. Eights feel they must control their environment, especially people, sometimes becoming confrontational and intimidating. Eights typically have problems with their tempers and with allowing themselves to be vulnerable. At their Best: self-mastering, they use their strength to improve others' lives, becoming heroic, magnanimous, and inspiring.
description_draft: This means needing to be in control, especially of people: self-confident, strong and straight-talking, protective and decisive, domineering, confrontational and intimidating at times, hot-tempered, and unable to let oneself be vulnerable.
nearest_existing: dominant / controlling / confrontational / self_assured (also blunt): the type is dominance with a protective side and a refusal of vulnerability; the plain dominant takes charge, the typed version must control, and the plain controlling lacks the straight talk and the protectiveness.
notes: 'At their Best' omitted as across the set. Nickname ('The Challenger') unnamed. One-liner identical on both pages. The source's 'sometimes becoming confrontational and intimidating' is rendered as 'confrontational and intimidating at times' (hedge kept as its plain-word equivalent, per the strength rule); 'ego-centric' and 'resourceful' did not fit at 32.

label: Enneagram 9
source_text: The Easygoing, Self-Effacing Type: Receptive, Reassuring, Agreeable, and Complacent. Enneagram Type Nines are accepting, trusting, and stable. They are usually creative, optimistic, and supportive, but can also be too willing to go along with others to keep the peace. They want everything to go smoothly and be without conflict, but they can also tend to be complacent, simplifying problems and minimizing anything upsetting. They typically have problems with inertia and stubbornness. At their Best: indomitable and all-embracing, they are able to bring people together and heal conflicts.
description_draft: This means wanting everything to go smoothly: accepting and trusting, going along with others too readily to keep the peace, playing down whatever is upsetting, complacent, slow to get moving, and stubborn.
nearest_existing: accommodating / conciliatory / placid / passive (also easygoing, agreeable): the type is accommodation for the sake of one's own peace of mind, with inertia and a stubborn core beneath the agreeableness; the plain accommodating has no such inertia and the plain placid no stubbornness.
notes: 'At their Best' omitted as across the set. Nickname ('The Peacemaker') unnamed. The type page's one-liner as fetched read 'Receptive, Reassuring Agreeable, and Complacent' (comma missing, almost certainly a rendering artefact); the overview page's punctuation is recorded. 'Supportive', 'creative', 'optimistic' and 'stable' did not fit at 32; the source's 'too willing' is kept as 'too readily', its 'tend to be complacent' as plain 'complacent', and 'inertia' as 'slow to get moving'.

label: enterprising (Holland)
source_text: Work involves managing, negotiating, marketing, or selling, typically in a business setting, or leading or advising people in political and legal situations. Enterprising occupations are often associated with business initiatives, sales, marketing/advertising, finance, management/administration, professional advising, public speaking, politics, or law.
description_draft: This means being drawn to work that moves people and closes deals: managing, negotiating, marketing and selling in business, or leading and advising others in politics and law, and speaking in public.
nearest_existing: ambitious / strategic / charismatic / career_oriented (also competitive, transactional): the typed version is a vocational pull toward managing, selling and leading, not a drive to rise; the plain ambitious could be an ambitious scientist, the enterprising type wants the deal, the podium and the business.
notes: 'Moves people and closes deals' is the gloss for 'managing, negotiating, marketing, or selling ... leading or advising'; 'finance' and 'business initiatives' did not fit at 32. Neutral strength, as the instrument is. Source situation as in the set_review on artistic (Holland).

label: Gemini
source_text: Keywords: talkative, mental, adaptable, flexible, changeable, responsive, sociable, superficial, versatile, inquisitive, witty. Sun in Gemini: With the Sun in Gemini, the urge for self-expression is strong. These natives are often just as interested in collecting information as they are in sharing it.
description_draft: This means living through talk: collecting information as eagerly as one passes it on, witty, sociable and quick to adapt, changeable from hour to hour, and skimming the surface of things.
nearest_existing: gregarious / quick_witted / mercurial / superficial (also inquisitive, adaptable): the sign is the talker's sociability joined to a quick, changeable, information-hungry mind that stays on the surface; the plain mercurial has the changeability without the talk.
notes: Element air, modality mutable. Source fallback as for the set (Wikipedia's Gemini (astrology) article has no portrait); cross-check astrology.com/zodiac-signs/gemini: 'they love to talk!', 'The more information a Gemini collects, the better', strengths 'Curious and playful', 'adaptability'; weaknesses 'Short attention span; may pursue surface-level discovery', 'non-committal, flaky'. Strength: 'superficial' and 'changeable' are the source's unflattering side and are kept; otherwise flattering.

label: investigative (Holland)
source_text: Work involves studying and researching non-living objects, living organisms, disease or other forms of impairment, or human behavior. Investigative occupations are often associated with physical, life, medical, or social sciences, and can be found in the fields of humanities, mathematics/statistics, information technology, or health care service.
description_draft: This means being drawn to work of study and research: into non-living matter, living organisms, disease, or human behavior, in the physical, life, medical or social sciences, mathematics, or information technology.
nearest_existing: analytical / inquisitive / empirical / curious (also cerebral): the typed version is a vocational interest in research as work, listing its objects and fields; the plain curious or inquisitive is a temperament that need not become a job.
notes: 'Non-living objects' rendered 'non-living matter'; 'other forms of impairment', 'humanities' and 'health care service' did not fit at 32. Neutral strength, as the instrument is. Source situation as in the set_review on artistic (Holland).

label: Leo
source_text: Keywords: magnanimous, generous, hospitable, caring, warm, authoritative, active, open. Sun in Leo: There's an unmistakably regal air to Solar Leos. These are dignified—even noble—folk. Leos have a reputation for being conceited, but think again. [astrology.com, Leo page, https://www.astrology.com/zodiac-signs/leo] "These folks are impossible to miss since they love being center stage." "Leos have a great sense of pride and loyalty"
description_draft: This means carrying oneself like royalty: warm, generous and openhanded as a host, dignified and used to being in charge, loving the limelight, and proud enough to be taken for conceited.
nearest_existing: charismatic / grandiose / generous / attention_seeking (also dignified, magnanimous): the sign is warmth and generosity worn with a regal pride and a hunger for the spotlight; the plain attention_seeking lacks the generosity and the plain generous the pride.
notes: Element fire, modality fixed. Source fallback as for the set (Wikipedia's Leo (astrology) article has no portrait); cross-check astrology.com/zodiac-signs/leo: 'love being center stage', 'personal magnetism', 'Warmth and enthusiasm', strengths 'courage and confidence', 'pride and loyalty', 'very generous'; weaknesses 'vanity and jealousy', 'ruthless and self-serving'. 'Loving the limelight' comes from the cross-check; Cafe Astrology's own keywords are all flattering and its text half-denies the conceit ('but think again'), so the draft keeps conceit only as a reputation ('proud enough to be taken for conceited'), mirroring that hedge. Strength: more flattering than the cross-check's 'vanity and jealousy'; flag for Roger (one of three such signs, with Capricorn and Pisces).

label: Libra
source_text: Keywords: just, sociable, refined, accommodating, kind, fair, diplomatic, likable, indecisive, respectful, artistic. Sun in Libra: Libra natives are generally thought to be sociable, somewhat intellectual souls. They have an almost innocent way about them that makes them very approachable. Generally quite eager to cooperate, Librans spend a lot of their time trying not to rock the boat. [astrology.com, Libra page, https://www.astrology.com/zodiac-signs/libra] "Libras are good when paired up, too, since they epitomize balance, harmony, and a sense of fair play." "They are great communicators and listeners, fairly weighing all sides of an argument and another's point of view."
description_draft: This means wanting everything fair and in balance: sociable, refined and eager to cooperate, weighing every side until deciding becomes hard, and taking pains not to rock the boat.
nearest_existing: diplomatic / fair / indecisive / conciliatory (also accommodating): the sign is fairness as a temperament, sociable and refined, with the indecision that weighing every side produces; the plain diplomatic manages others, the typed version wants balance for its own sake.
notes: Element air, modality cardinal. Source fallback as for the set (Wikipedia's Libra (astrology) article has no portrait beyond Manilius on Roman judges); cross-check astrology.com/zodiac-signs/libra: 'epitomize balance, harmony, and a sense of fair play', 'fairly weighing all sides', 'Keeping the peace'; weaknesses 'The classic Libra indecisiveness', suppressed anger solidifying into resentment. 'Not rock the boat' is the source's own idiom, kept because it is the conventional Libra phrase. Strength: mild on both sides in both sources (indecisive the only fault); kept mild.

label: Pisces
source_text: Keywords: intuitive, dreamy, artistic, humane, sympathetic, sensitive, compassionate, perceptive, tender, impressionable. Sun in Pisces: As the twelfth and last sign of the zodiac, Pisces contains within itself a little experience of all the signs. This gives Pisces Suns the ability to identify with people from all walks of life—from all backgrounds—in some way. These individuals are not only changeable and adaptable, but they also have open minds and tremendous understanding. [astrology.com, Pisces page, https://www.astrology.com/zodiac-signs/pisces] "They may take certain comments too much to heart and get easily wounded emotionally"
description_draft: This means feeling one's way through life: dreamy, tender and intuitive, identifying with almost anyone, taking on the moods around one, open-minded and understanding, and easily wounded by a careless word.
nearest_existing: empathetic / sentimental / intuitive / thin_skinned (also ethereal, compassionate, mystical): the sign is empathy as porousness, taking on others' moods and identifying with anyone, dreamy rather than practical; the plain empathetic understands others without dissolving into them.
notes: Element water, modality mutable. Source fallback as for the set (Wikipedia's Pisces (astrology) article has no portrait); cross-check astrology.com/zodiac-signs/pisces: 'selfless, spiritual, and very focused on their inner journey', 'intuition ... highly evolved', 'dreams and secrets', 'illusory world'; weaknesses 'get easily wounded emotionally', 'escapism, self-medication, and avoidance', 'codependent'. 'Easily wounded' comes from the cross-check and from the keyword 'impressionable' (also rendered 'taking on the moods around one'); 'spiritual' and 'escapism' did not fit at 32. Strength: Cafe Astrology's keywords are all flattering or neutral ('impressionable' the only soft fault), so the draft is gentle and milder than the cross-check's escapism and codependence; flag for Roger (with Capricorn and Leo).

label: realistic (Holland)
source_text: Work involves designing, building, or repairing of equipment, materials, or structures, engaging in physical activity, or working outdoors. Realistic occupations are often associated with engineering, mechanics and electronics, construction, woodworking, transportation, machine operation, agriculture, animal services, physical or manual labor, athletics, or protective services.
description_draft: This means being drawn to work done with the hands: designing, building and repairing equipment, materials and structures, operating machines, working outdoors with plants and animals, and physical or manual labor.
nearest_existing: hands_on / practical / concrete (also rural, technical): the typed version is a vocational interest in building, fixing and physical work with things; the plain hands_on is a working style (doing it oneself) that a manager could have, and practical is a cast of mind.
notes: 'Done with the hands' is the gloss; 'engineering', 'transportation', 'athletics' and 'protective services' did not fit at 32; 'agriculture, animal services' rendered 'plants and animals'. Neutral strength, as the instrument is. Source situation as in the set_review on artistic (Holland).

label: Sagittarius
source_text: Keywords: optimistic, restless, enthusiastic, adventurous, honest, irresponsible, outspoken, independent. Sun in Sagittarius: Restless, cheerful, and friendly, Sun in Sagittarius people are generally on the go. They have a love of freedom, and a disdain for routine. Generally quite easygoing, Sagittarians make friends with people from all walks of life.
description_draft: This means being always on the go: cheerful, restless and adventurous, in love with freedom and contemptuous of routine, blurting out the truth as one sees it, and making friends everywhere.
nearest_existing: adventurous / restless / optimistic / blunt (also candid, independent, globetrotter): the sign is adventurousness as a whole temperament, cheerful and outspoken, with the irresponsibility that a love of freedom brings; the plain adventurous seeks risk, the typed version seeks the open road and the big idea.
notes: Element fire, modality mutable. Source fallback as for the set (Wikipedia's Sagittarius (astrology) article has no portrait beyond the archer's 'power of prophecy'); cross-check astrology.com/zodiac-signs/sagittarius: 'wanderers of the zodiac', 'truth-seekers', 'keenly interested in philosophy and religion', strength 'optimism', 'you will always know where you stand'; weaknesses 'famously non-committal', 'ungrounded and unrealistic', condescension. 'Blurting out the truth' renders 'honest, outspoken' plus the cross-check's bluntness; 'irresponsible' from the keywords is carried only by 'contemptuous of routine', and the cross-check's philosophical bent did not fit at 32. Strength: roughly even in the source; kept.

label: Scorpio
source_text: Keywords: passionate, perceptive, resourceful, possessive, psychological, prowling, determined, probing, fixed, focused. Sun in Scorpio: Scorpios are known for their intensity. They are determined folk that absolutely throw themselves into whatever they do — but getting them to commit to something is rarely an easy task. [astrology.com, Scorpio page, https://www.astrology.com/zodiac-signs/scorpio] "Magnetic and mysterious"; "receptive and patient, letting others play their cards and show their intentions first"; "can be suspicious and slow to trust"; "can be slow to forgive, and those that cross the Scorpion may feel their vengeful sting"
description_draft: This means being intense about everything: throwing oneself wholly into what one has chosen, probing other people's motives and keeping one's own hidden, possessive, slow to trust, and not forgetting a wrong.
nearest_existing: intense / guarded / vindictive / passionate (also clingy for the possessiveness, obsessive): the sign is intensity turned on people, probing them while concealing oneself, with possessiveness and a long memory for injuries; the plain intense has no secrecy and the plain vindictive no passion.
notes: Element water, modality fixed. Source fallback as for the set (Wikipedia's Scorpio (astrology) article has no portrait); cross-check astrology.com/zodiac-signs/scorpio: 'dead serious in their mission to learn about others', 'black and white', 'Magnetic and mysterious', 'letting others play their cards and show their intentions first'; weaknesses 'suspicious and slow to trust', 'emotionally manipulative and controlling', 'slow to forgive ... vengeful sting', 'needy and obsessive'. 'Slow to trust' and 'not forgetting a wrong' come from the cross-check (and from the keyword 'possessive'); the source's own 'rarely easy to commit' is folded into 'slow to trust'. Strength: keywords mixed ('possessive, prowling, probing' against 'passionate, resourceful'); kept, and this is the least flattering of the twelve, as the conventional portrait is.

label: social (Holland)
source_text: Work involves helping, teaching, advising, assisting, or providing service to others. Social occupations are often associated with social, health care, personal service, teaching/education, or religious activities.
description_draft: This means being drawn to work that is done for other people: helping, teaching, advising, assisting or serving them, in classrooms, clinics, social and personal services, or religious life.
nearest_existing: helpful / nurturing / other_focused / altruistic (also supportive, didactic): the typed version is a vocational interest in people-work, helping and teaching as a job; the plain helpful is a disposition in any setting and altruistic a motive; the typed version names the settings, not the motive.
notes: 'Classrooms, clinics' render 'teaching/education' and 'health care'. Neutral strength, as the instrument is. Source situation as in the set_review on artistic (Holland).

label: Taurus
source_text: Keywords: persevering, down-to-earth, stable, stubborn, possessive, prosperous, dependable, physical, sensual. Sun in Taurus: There is something very solid about Taurus natives, no matter what the rest of their charts say about them. Though they are dependable most of the time, this generally shows itself more in habit than in outright helpfulness. Taurus natives are sensual folk–and this includes sex, but extends to pleasures in all areas... [astrology.com, Taurus page, https://www.astrology.com/zodiac-signs/taurus] "May become overly materialistic or focused on comfort"
description_draft: This means being solid and hard to shift: steady in one's habits, dependable, fond of comfort and bodily pleasures of every kind, holding on to what one has, and plain stubborn.
nearest_existing: steady / unyielding / epicurean / dependable (also hedonistic, materialistic, settled): the sign is steadiness with a sensual, comfort-loving side and a possessive stubbornness; the plain steady has no appetite and the plain epicurean no immovability.
notes: Element earth, modality fixed. Source fallback as for the set (Wikipedia's Taurus (astrology) article has no portrait beyond 'stabilizes what Aries started'); cross-check astrology.com/zodiac-signs/taurus: 'Grounded · Patient · Loyal · Sensual · Stubborn'; strengths 'Steadfast and reliable', 'Deep appreciation for beauty, art, and nature'; challenges 'resistant to change', 'stubbornness or possessiveness', 'overly materialistic or focused on comfort', 'Slow to forgive'. 'Holding on to what one has' renders 'possessive'. Strength: keywords mixed (stubborn, possessive against dependable, persevering); kept.

label: Virgo
source_text: Keywords: analytical, intelligent, reserved, critical, helpful, conscientious. Sun in Virgo: It is rare to find the stereotypical nitpicky, exacting, 'clean freak' in modern-day Virgos. Although the sign of Virgo has evolved with the times, there are some unmistakable traits that remain. Virgo people are generally respectable, hard-working individuals who have a love of knowledge and know-how. [astrology.com, Virgo page, https://www.astrology.com/zodiac-signs/virgo] "Virgo is the sixth sign of the zodiac, to be exact, and that's the way Virgos like it: exacting."
description_draft: This means being exacting in a useful way: hard-working, analytical and reserved, loving knowledge and know-how, noticing every flaw and saying so, and putting that skill to the service of others.
nearest_existing: meticulous / critical / fastidious / perfectionist (also helpful, conscientious, analytical): the sign is exactness in the service of others; the plain meticulous is exact for its own sake and the plain critical finds fault without the helpfulness.
notes: Element earth, modality mutable. Source fallback as for the set (Wikipedia's Virgo (astrology) article has no portrait); cross-check astrology.com/zodiac-signs/virgo: 'exacting', 'picky and critical (and they can be), but their attention to detail is for a reason: to help others', 'meticulous nature', 'serving, healing, and helping to bring order'; weaknesses worry and anxiety, noticing 'flaws and inefficiencies in themselves and others'. The source itself distances the sign from the 'nitpicky' stereotype while listing 'critical' among the keywords; the draft keeps the criticism as plain behavior ('noticing every flaw and saying so') and the helpful purpose from both sources. Strength: balanced in both sources; kept.
